scope: Additional safe classroom experiment concepts only.

experiments.title: Ice melting
experiments.focus: Show a simple phase change from solid to liquid water.
student_observations: The solid becomes liquid in the model.
Phase change does not create a new substance.
experiments.teacher_note: A basic phase-change example for review lessons.

experiments.title: Chalk suspension
experiments.focus: Show that some solids make cloudy mixtures instead of true solutions.
student_observations: The solid does not disappear completely.
Suspensions are different from clear solutions.
experiments.teacher_note: Useful for comparing with sugar and salt behavior.

experiments.title: Soap and water bubbles
experiments.focus: Introduce the idea that some substances change surface behavior in water.
student_observations: Bubbles are easier to represent in the model.
Soap helps show cleaning and mixing behavior.
Different liquids can behave differently in water.
experiments.teacher_note: Keep the lesson conceptual and classroom-level.

experiments.title: Mixture review
experiments.focus: Review how solids and liquids can behave differently in classroom mixtures.
